seo.title: Terms of use
seo.seo_title: Terms of use for the Nexora site and services
seo.seo_description: Purpose, accounts, offers, prices and taxes, termination, export, liability and governing law. Draft template, to be completed and reviewed before publication.

blocks.role: Gabarit juridique en brouillon : rubriques en place, informations à compléter.

translation.headline: Terms of use.
translation.subheadline: Draft template: the headings are in place; the commercial terms are for the founder to set.

translation.title: Purpose and acceptance.
translation.body: These terms govern use of Nexora's site and services. The services are aimed at businesses; confirm whether they are also aimed at individuals, which changes the applicable rules [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER]. Method of acceptance (click, signature) [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: Accounts and access.
translation.body: Account creation and security, accuracy of information, responsibility for credentials. To be specified when the customer area opens [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: Services and offers.
translation.body: Description of the services (diagnosis, installation, automation, operations) and of self-service offers once they open. No self-service offer is open today. Status of each offer [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: Prices, taxes and payment.
translation.body: Prices shown, before or after tax, applicable GST and QST, payment methods, billing, taxes on credits, renewals and refund terms [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. No price is set today. Text [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

translation.title: Termination and export.
translation.body: Termination terms for each party. At the end of the contract, the customer's documents, configurations and workflows remain exportable: formats, time frames and erasure of data [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

translation.title: Our liability.
translation.body: Extent and limits of Nexora's liability, human supervision of AI outputs, force majeure [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

translation.title: Governing law and amendments.
translation.body: Quebec law and applicable federal laws; competent courts [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER]. Language of the contract documents [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER]. How the terms may be amended [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER].

blocks.role: Liste de ce que le fondateur doit compléter ou faire valider avant toute publication.

translation.title: To do before publishing.
translation.body: This page is a template. It stays a draft, unpublished and not indexed, until the following points are settled.

items.title: Fill in the markers.
items.text: Every [TO BE COMPLETED BY THE FOUNDER] must be replaced with the real information; no value is invented.

items.title: Have a lawyer review it.
items.text: The text must be reviewed by a Quebec lawyer [TO BE REVIEWED BY A QUEBEC LAWYER].

items.title: Approve, then publish.
items.text: Only after these two points, remove the draft status and the indexing ban.
